items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: And Joe and the Happy Bruns, and Holly Shalane.

ctx.x: The only guy who plays violin, they don't play corny. And good tempo, man. He likes all the tunes that I like, man. This man had the first Walsh record in the city of New Orleans, Walsh automobile, on the Island Broad, and he was Chaps. Man, big diamond ring, he was a good friend of the guy, they owned a little club, Tony Dianapolis. And Mike had the Hatsitatsi. And Joe Capra was playing banjo up there. Joe and the Happy Bruns, and Holly Shalane. Oh, man. And I played the TMA club, man. With Jack Lapine, man.…
What did you talk to, Benny?
